title: Number of Students Doing Homework at a Given Time
summary: Given start and end times for each of several students' homework sessions and a specific query time, count how many students are engaged in homework at that exact moment.
statement: Given start and end times for each of several students' homework sessions and a specific query time, count how many students are engaged in homework at that exact moment.
constraints: Student i works throughout the inclusive interval start_time[i] through end_time[i].
reference_solution:
def active_students_at_time(start_time, end_time, query_time):
 return sum(start<=query_time<=end for start,end in zip(start_time,end_time))
hints: Pair corresponding start and end values.
Test the inclusive condition start <= query <= end.
Intervals are independent, so the sum of membership indicators is exactly the number active.
